summary: Nifty futures fell ~300 pts, spot broke 25,900 and closed 25,960; expiry day with GIFT Nifty -90/100. VIX jumped ~10% as the market fell without news. Key support: December first-session low 25,844; hedge adjustments shown; 25,800-26,100 range view; Fed decision next night.

events.claim: Nifty broke 26,000 in 11 of the last 18 trading sessions (intraday or close)
Nifty Next 50 one-year return turned negative while Nifty 50 stayed positive
US Fed rate decision due the following night (Dec 10, 2025)
Indigo airline disruptions cited as the main India-specific negative news

lessons: VIX spikes when a market falls without a stated reason - unexplained selling signals positioning stress, not news.
Expiry day plus the day before amplifies moves because put sellers convert to futures shorts.
quote: When markets fall for no reason, until the market finds a reason, the volatility index will shoot up.

summary: Nifty down ~500-600 pts in two sessions; 26,000 PE exploded from ~20 to 300+ (gamma effect near expiry). Paper-traded Jan vs Dec-2026 short straddles shown; argued long-term options suit violent markets; ~450 NSE stocks (15%) hit 52-week lows; hybrid-fund (75 debt/25 equity) advice.

events.claim: 26,000 strike weekly put rose from about 20 to over 300 in two sessions into expiry (gamma effect)
About 450 of ~3,000 NSE-listed stocks (~15%) hit 52-week lows on Dec 9, 2025
Nifty lot size changes from 75 to 65 from January 2026
Trump threatened tariffs on Indian agriculture products (Dec 2025)

lessons: Near expiry, small index moves cause outsized option losses (gamma effect) - size down or avoid short-dated selling.
Hybrid equity+debt allocation with rebalancing beats pure equity on a risk-adjusted basis.
quote: Short-term trades are subject to the gamma effect - keep part of the portfolio in long-term options.
leaks: workshop promotion ('in our workshop','I am the only trainer who talks about long term options')

summary: Fed day: 25 bp cut expected with hawkish-tone risk; FIIs sold 3,000+ cr; ~50-pt gap down. Nov-12 gap near 25,700 almost filled. 26,000 straddle (combined ~500) implied 25,500-26,500. IPO euphoria flagged (~14 IPOs last week; Meesho listed); silver ATH $61; MCX futures ATH 10,500.

events.claim: US Fed expected to cut rates 25 bp on Dec 10, 2025, with hawkish-guidance risk
FIIs sold over 3,000 crore in cash on Dec 9, 2025
About 14 IPOs launched in one week (Dec 2025) with heavy premiums; Meesho IPO subscribed ~50x, listed Dec 10
Silver hit an all-time high of $61; MCX stock futures hit all-time high ~10,500

lessons: IPO euphoria clusters near market-cycle tops (2008 Reliance Power parallel).
A rate cut paired with hawkish commentary can still hurt equities - the tone matters more than the cut.
quote: When there is too much IPO euphoria, remember we are somewhere at the top of the market cycle.

summary: Nifty broke the December first-session low (25,844); morning recovery sold into; lowest December close. Bank Nifty -500 high-to-low; MCX and BSE -5% each, attributed to margin calls. Range view 25,500-26,500; Fed decision overnight; 26,000 now stiff resistance.

events.claim: MCX and BSE stocks each fell ~5% on Dec 10, 2025, attributed to margin-call selling
Microsoft to invest $17.5 billion and Amazon $35 billion in India for AI (reported around Dec 10, 2025)
Nifty closed below its December-series first-session low (~25,844) - structurally bearish signal

lessons: If a series' first-session low breaks, the month's structure turns bearish - treat it as a regime tell.
Event-day positioning: shorts are covered ahead of a possible positive surprise, then re-emerge after.
leaks: US-trading workshop promo with contact-office CTA

summary: Nifty snapped a 3-day fall with a big green candle; broke 25,700 then short-covering +200. Pattern noted: 3-4 red days then one big green candle. Fed delivered a dovish cut; Oracle's weak results hit US tech. Gang analogy for bull/bear crowd dynamics.

events.claim: US Fed cut rates on Dec 10, 2025 with dovish tone; US markets initially positive
Oracle's weak results triggered a US tech-led selloff (~Dec 11, 2025)
Nifty round trip: ~26,000 (Oct 2024) to 21,700 low and back to ~26,000 within ~14 months - zero net move

lessons: Extreme intraday volatility usually marks a topping or bottoming process, not a trend.
Two-way 100-200 point days argue for long-dated positions over short-term gamma exposure.
quote: If you are weak, I will beat you like anything; if I am weak, I will run away - that is bulls versus bears.

summary: Unexplained ~120-pt gap up. Taught gap-fill mechanics: Nov-12 gap (~150 pts) was filled 20-21 sessions later at 25,693 and the market bounced. Support 25,700, resistance 26,300 (ATH); VIX 10.4 near multi-year low; FIIs sold every December session except the first.

events.claim: Nifty's Nov 12, 2025 gap-up (~150 pts) was fully filled on Dec 11, 2025 at ~25,693, ~21 sessions later
India VIX ~10.4, near multi-year lows (Dec 2025)
FIIs net sellers in every December-series session except the first (as of Dec 12, 2025)

lessons: Unfilled gaps act like debt the market repays; the fill level often becomes support/resistance.
A gap-up on no news reflects positioning, not sentiment - expect consolidation or fade it.
quote: After 21 trading sessions Nifty came down and exactly closed the gap - sometimes these technicals work perfectly.

summary: Broad-based rally; Nifty closed ~150 pts higher above 26,000 - a psychological win for bulls. India VIX ~10.05, near single digits. Rally attributed to a Modi-US President phone call and hopes of tariff relief tied to a Russian-crude halt claim; FMCG lagged.

events.claim: India VIX closed ~10.05 (Dec 12, 2025), close to a single-digit print
Reported phone call between the Indian PM and US President fueled trade-deal hopes (Dec 11, 2025)
US politician claimed India stopped buying Russian crude, raising hopes the 25% tariff would be cut

lessons: Index round-number closes (26,000) act as psychological battle lines for positioning.
Consolidation ranges compress over time (25,000±600 → 26,000±300); compression precedes expansion.
dup_flag: Oct-2024 straddle anecdote and May-12-2025 ceasefire recap repeat

summary: US fell Friday (Nasdaq -2%+; Nasdaq-100 below 25,000); GIFT Nifty -100+. Warned the Accenture read-through for Indian IT is weak (H1B/fee differences). FIIs: 13 straight selling sessions; mid/smallcap margin-trade unwinding (9-12% funding); advance tax from Dec 15 dries liquidity; US quadruple witching Friday.

events.claim: FIIs net sellers for 13 consecutive sessions (as of Dec 12, 2025) - among the longest streaks
Nasdaq-100 broke below 25,000 around Dec 12, 2025
Margin-trade-funding unwinding in mid/small caps; funding costs 9-12% (Dec 2025)
US monthly jobs report delayed to mid-December 2025 by a ~40-day government shutdown

lessons: December 15-31 is seasonally weak in India (advance tax, year-end squaring) - don't force trends.
Accenture results are a weak read-through for Indian IT because visa/fee regimes differ.

summary: Volatile day, bulls won: morning break of 25,900 reversed; IT and PSU banks led recovery; Bank Nifty rose a third straight day despite HDFC Bank (highest weight, falling). Rupee at all-time low above 91; gold rising; auto sold on a Brazil-related duty report.

events.claim: HDFC Bank's Bank Nifty weight ~30%, set to fall to ~25% via the index rejig
Indian rupee hit an all-time low above 91 per USD (Dec 2025)
Auto stocks sold on a Brazil-related duty/tariff report (Dec 15, 2025)

lessons: A heavyweight's fall can be absorbed when breadth is strong - watch who leads recovery, not just the index.
Ultra-low VIX (~10) means premiums decay fast; sellers profit but a spike is overdue.
quote: History doesn't repeat in markets: first time it is a shock, second time it is just news.

summary: Jittery pre-jobs-data tape: the US monthly jobs report was delayed to mid-December by a ~40-day government shutdown; Nasdaq-100 broke 25,000. FIIs: 13 straight selling sessions; mid/smallcap margin-trade unwinding; capitulation risk in the broader market; GIFT Nifty -50 vs -100 implied (relative resilience).

events.claim: US November jobs report delayed to ~Dec 16, 2025 by a ~40-day federal government shutdown
FIIs net sellers for 13 consecutive sessions (mid-Dec 2025)
Nasdaq-100 broke below 25,000 (Dec 15-16, 2025)
Tesla trading at a P/E above 300 during the AI-led selloff

lessons: US data days make Indian markets jittery in both directions - treat scheduled macro prints as volatility events.
India's year-long underperformance acts as a cushion: AI-bubble damage lands elsewhere first.

summary: Nifty closed well below 26,000 (~-150). Rupee at all-time low above 91 despite strong export data; Axis Bank's NIM warning (-5%) dragged banks toward a ~59,000 swing low. Questioned official data (CPI 0.25%, GDP 8.2%); Nifty YTD only ~3-3.5%. In low VIX, prefer ratios/calendars over naked selling.

events.claim: Axis Bank guided to another quarter of NIM pressure; stock fell ~5% (Dec 16, 2025)
India CPI inflation printed ~0.25% for two consecutive months (late 2025)
Indian GDP growth cited at 8.2% with inflation ~0.25% - 'Goldilocks' data questioned
Rupee hit an all-time low above 91/USD despite positive export data

lessons: When the currency falls despite good trade data, trust price action over headline statistics.
In ultra-low VIX, use defined-risk combos (ratios, calendars) - naked selling is mispriced.
quote: Only the crying baby gets the chocolates - the market must keep crying until the budget.

summary: Nasdaq recovered to green; S&P/Dow lower; quadruple witching Friday in US (S&P consolidating 6,800±200). Nifty held 25,850; 25,700 monthly swing low intact. OI: calls sold 26,000-26,500, puts 26,000-25,500; Bank Nifty 59,000 PE big OI; Brent below $60 (6-7 month low).

events.claim: FIIs net sellers for 14 consecutive sessions (as of Dec 16, 2025); the prior 14-day streak (Jul-Aug 2025) saw ~4% fall then a strong rally
Brent crude fell below $60 - a 6-7 month low (Dec 2025)
S&P 500 consolidating around 6,800 ±200 (Dec 2025)

lessons: Range-bound OI (calls above, puts below) confirms consolidation - trade the range until it breaks.
A 14-session FII selling streak has preceded rallies before; flows alone don't set direction.

summary: Flat open became a failed trending day: HDFC Bank (-15 ≈ 300 Bank Nifty pts) and ICICI fell all day; SBI starred near ₹1,000. India VIX closed below 10 for the first time (single digit). FII selling streak at 14; today would be a record 15th. Lot-size change forced square-ups before Dec 22 at some brokers.

events.claim: India VIX closed below 10 for the first time (mid-Dec 2025)
SBI approached the 1,000 level, contributing most positive Nifty points (Dec 17, 2025)
ICICI Bank ~10% below its all-time high amid Bank Nifty rejig-related selling

lessons: Index-level reads hide stock-specific wars; subtract the drag stock to see true breadth.
Institutional commentary acknowledging LTCG/STCG hikes as an FII-outflow driver validates tax sensitivity of flows.

summary: Fourth straight fall; explained the Nifty lot-size change 75→65 (975 qty = 13 lots now, 15 after) and odd-lot handling. HDFC dragged; defense stocks fell a 4th day on Russia-Ukraine peace talks; autos a 4th day as rupee weakness erased fuel-cut hopes. FIIs bought 1,000+ cr, ending the streak at 14; VIX decisively below 10.

events.claim: FIIs bought over 1,000 crore on Dec 18, 2025, ending a 14-session selling streak
Defense stocks fell for a fourth straight day on Russia-Ukraine peace-negotiation progress (Dec 2025)
GST rate cuts: announced by the PM on Aug 15, 2025, implemented from Sept 22, 2025

lessons: Lot-size changes force position rebalancing; keep quantity in tradable multiples or face odd-lot expiry.
Index-constituent rebalancing creates predictable multi-week supply in the capped heavyweight.

summary: Smart recovery after four red days; broad-based, mid/small caps outperformed; Nifty futures premium expanded 5-10 pts (short covering). 26,000 straddle decayed 500→~300 (>15,000/lot). BoJ hiked 25 bp with no carry-trade crash. 2025 among the worst years for stocks+currency; US/Japan/HK/Korea +20-25% YTD.

events.claim: Bank of Japan hiked rates 25 bp in Dec 2025 without triggering a yen-carry unwind selloff
India VIX ~9.5 (Dec 19, 2025), near record lows
Major global markets (US, Japan, Hong Kong, South Korea) up 20-25% in 2025 while India underperformed

lessons: When a feared macro event repeats without damage, markets stop reacting - first hit is shock, second is news.
Friday optimism followed by Monday/Tuesday weakness was this month's recurring trap for option sellers.
quote: The first time it comes is a shock; the second time it comes, it is news.

summary: Risk-on Monday: crude, gold, silver at highs, cryptos up; GIFT Nifty +130. Santa-rally hopes; Accenture results boosted IT sentiment but India-specific risks (H1B fees, no trade deal) cap enthusiasm; TCS rebounded ~3,090→3,300+. Ranges unchanged: 25,700-26,300 weekly / 25,500-26,500 monthly.

events.claim: Gold and silver hit fresh all-time highs in international markets (Dec 22, 2025)
China left interest rates unchanged despite weak data (Dec 2025)
TCS recovered from ~3,090 to above 3,300 in late December 2025

lessons: A strong January historically colors the whole year in Indian markets - year-start positioning matters.
Read-through rallies need the same underlying drivers; different visa/tax regimes break the link.

summary: Third straight up day (+200); commodity complex on fire - silver/gold ATHs, Hindustan Zinc and MCX (proxies) surged; BSE strong on new-monthly-options rumors. Infosys top contributor (Accenture read-through + US short squeeze); four stocks drove >50% of the rally. Rupee appreciated (RBI intervention suspected).

events.claim: Infosys, ICICI Bank, Reliance and Bharti Airtel together contributed over 50% of Nifty's Dec 22 rally
MCX stock rose ~5% to a fresh all-time high on gold/silver strength (Dec 22, 2025)
RBI suspected of intervening to lift the rupee (Dec 2025)

lessons: Consolidation months are the option writer's harvest - non-directional strategies monetize range behavior.
Commodity proxies (Hindustan Zinc, MCX) become high-beta plays on precious-metal manias.

summary: Pre-Christmas quiet: US steady (VIX <15), GDP + PCE data due; premiums 'pathetic'. Silver +100% in a year; gold ~2% above its $4,400 ATH. RBI reportedly spent $11B defending the rupee; rupee ~100-150 paise off the low. Watch Infosys for Friday-gain unwind; banks' ADRs firm; range 26,000-26,300.

events.claim: RBI reportedly spent $11 billion defending the rupee (Dec 2025)
Gold ~2% above its prior ~$4,400 all-time high; silver roughly doubled in 2025 (~$68)
Infosys's Friday ADR surge (~5%) fully unwound by Dec 22 - selling risk flagged

lessons: Between Christmas and New Year, thin books exaggerate moves; professionals close books before the holiday.
When premiums are too low to sell, buy-side structures (hedges) are nearly free - use them.

summary: Afternoon rally above the ~26,116 all-time-closing-high failed in the last hour; flat/negative close (NSE weighted average showed positive). India VIX fell ~3% to close below 9.5 (intraday 9.1). Speaker squared up all long-term trades (kept hedges), planning re-entry after the budget where he expects 'something very big'.

events.claim: Nifty traded above the all-time closing high (~26,116) intraday on Dec 23, 2025 but could not hold
India VIX closed below 9.5 for the first time (Dec 23, 2025)
Only HDFC Bank of the five tracked heavyweights (RIL, HDFC, ICICI, INFY, TCS) closed strong (Dec 23, 2025)

lessons: Failed moves at all-time highs are themselves information - supply appears exactly where bulls need it.
Use record-low VIX as cheap insurance: square up long-term exposure and re-arm after catalysts.

summary: Christmas Eve: US half-day, Europe shut; thin volumes with spike risk. Gold broke its ~$4,400 ATH and ran 3-4%; silver ~$68 (+40% past $50). 26,200 straddle ~200 (range 26,000-26,400). Watchpoints: VIX below 9.1 record, Nifty above 26,216 (close ATH) / 26,300 (intraday ATH); caps upside at 26,500.

events.claim: Silver traded ~$68 after rising ~40% past $50 (Dec 2025)
A 4-days-to-expiry ATM straddle (~200 pts) matched last year's 3.5-hours-before-expiry price - record-low VIX regime
BSE mid/small-cap indices still below December-series highs while large caps recovered (2025 divergence)

lessons: Low VIX punishes pure selling; pair buys with sells so a spike pays instead of hurts.
Hedge costs collapse when premiums collapse - there is never a cheaper time to insure a book.

summary: FIIs sold before the close; Nifty ~-100 and repeatedly rejected above 26,100. India VIX closed ~9.2 - the lowest close since its 2008-09 introduction. One-year-away straddle premiums >10% below year-ago. Reliance worst; TCS rallied to day-high. Teased a 'very big crash in 2026' video, in tension with his earlier 30,000 target.

events.claim: India VIX closed at ~9.2, its lowest closing since inception (Dec 24, 2025)
Long-dated (one-year) straddle premiums >10% below year-ago levels (Dec 2025)
Manappuram Finance +5-6% as gold-lending economics improve with record gold (Dec 24, 2025)
BSE denied rumors of new monthly index options; BSE stock fell (Dec 24, 2025)

lessons: Record-low VIX means the market prices serenity - position for the surprise, not the consensus.
Gold-lender equities are leveraged gold plays; metal rallies flow straight into their loan book.

summary: Post-Christmas consolidation; GIFT -40 distrusted. Showed his own put butterfly (26,200 buy / 26,000-25,800 sells) and call butterfly (26,200 buy / 26,300-500 sells) targeting a 26,000-26,300 close. Rule for record-low VIX: carry both buys and sells, prefer butterflies/ratios, avoid naked straddles. Budget: go in without positions.

events.claim: Nifty futures premium contracted sharply approaching series end (late Dec 2025)
Hindustan Copper at all-time high amid the copper rally (Dec 2025)
FIIs resumed net selling on Dec 24, 2025

lessons: Butterflies monetize a pinpoint view; both-wing structures pay exactly when the market stays pinned.
Into event risk with record-low VIX, flat is a position - keep dry powder for post-event re-entry.
quote: This is not the time for straddle or strangle... it is time for butterfly and ratio spreads.

summary: Unexplained ~100-pt fall; IT index plus HDFC/ICICI dragged. Explained rejig mechanics: exchange-standard funds short futures against mandatory cash sales of HDFC/ICICI, so dips can deepen into expiry. India VIX again at lowest-ever close. '90% of stocks down 20%+ from highs'; gold/silver investors beat equity in 2025.

events.claim: Roughly 90% of NSE stocks were >20% below their highs (late Dec 2025) while indices held near highs
Index funds' mandatory HDFC/ICICI sales (Bank Nifty rejig) fuelled dips into year-end via futures-hedged selling
YouTube removed the speaker's 5-year-old '100 crore' video under its unrealistic-returns thumbnail policy

lessons: Index rebalancing creates mechanical, predictable flow - know who must sell and when before trading dips.
Headline index health can mask broad-market decay; always check the median stock against the index.

summary: Fourth red day; Nifty broke 26,000 and closed below 25,950. Silver whipsawed (-7% intraday); commodities in commotion; India VIX finally rose meaningfully (first time in the streak) while US VIX jumped ~10%. Bank Nifty faces institution reversal-trades around HDFC/ICICI. Budget-hope 'crying baby' framing continues.

events.claim: Silver fell over 7% from intraday highs on Dec 29, 2025 after a parabolic run
India VIX rose significantly for the first time in weeks (Dec 29, 2025); US VIX up ~10%
Infosys's fresher salary-hike report pressured Indian IT stocks despite firm global tech (Dec 29, 2025)

lessons: Parabolic commodities correct violently; a 7% silver intraday reversal is a regime warning, not noise.
The first VIX uptick after weeks of record lows often marks the end of complacency - reduce short gamma.
quote: Hope is the worst enemy in the stock market.

summary: December series closed with bulls disappointed below 26,000; Bank Nifty swung -500/+500 on rejig-driven flows. Recited the expiry-at-lows → next-series-rally pattern (Sept→Oct +6%; Nov→Dec first session). Lot sizes change next day: Nifty 75→65, Bank Nifty 35→30. 2025: large caps ~+9%, small caps negative.

events.claim: Nifty lot size changed 75→65 and Bank Nifty 35→30 effective Jan 1, 2026
2025 returns: Nifty large caps ~+9%, small caps negative - a rare large-cap-led year
Pattern claim: September's 8-day fall was followed by October's ~6% rally; November lows were wiped in one December session

lessons: Series-expiry lows have preceded next-series rallies in recent months - but pattern trades need stops.
Lot-size cuts do not cut contract value proportionally - leverage discipline must stay intact.
